evals.name: registration-owner
evals.prompt: A librarian registers a new author. Draw the timeline before writing a model.
evals.expected_output: Follow the intent through the author's history to the visible row.
assertions: Separates the librarian from the author ID.
Names a past-tense business event rather than a database update.
Traces the displayed name back to the event.

evals.name: unknown-refusal
evals.prompt: The drawing only shows registering Aster. Document what happens with a blank name.
assertions: Changes the name without changing caller or author ID.
Asks the domain owner what refusal and unchanged state to expect.
Does not present a guessed rule as accepted.

evals.name: backtrack-author
evals.prompt: An editor sees Aster in the authors list. Work backward from that row.
evals.expected_output: Identify the origin of both row key and name.
assertions: Identifies the author as the history owner.
Traces the displayed name to AuthorRegistered.
Identifies RegisterAuthor as the request rather than the fact.
